candidates.description: This feature vector represents chemical compounds, medications, and related material substances.
This vector represents comparative adjectives and adverbial degree modifiers indicating scale, magnitude, or temporal relation.
This vector represents medical conditions, psychiatric symptoms, and physiological side effects.
This vector represents substances, medications, and medical conditions related to health, pharmacology, and intoxicating substances.
This vector represents quantitative measurements and physical dimensions of various scales, amounts, and extents.
These tokens function as conjunctive adverbs and adverbial modifiers expressing frequency, logical consequence, or epistemic modality.
This feature vector activates on tokens related to smoking, tobacco, and substances or processes associated with burning and chemical compounds.
This vector represents verbs of communication, observation, or evidence that introduce findings, statements, or conclusions.
This vector represents concepts of frequency, recurrence, and typical occurrence across various contexts.
This feature vector represents biological classification and taxonomic categories.
